{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module SmartContract.Pool where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.Async
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, catch)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word64)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Connection pool for blockchain node RPC
data NodeConn = NodeConn
  { connId     :: !Word64
  , connAlive  :: !(IORef Bool)
  , connNonce  :: !(IORef Word64)
  }

data Pool = Pool
  { poolConns   :: !(MVar [NodeConn])
  , poolSize    :: !Int
  , poolCounter :: !(IORef Word64)
  }

-- Transaction callback state
data TxCallback = TxCallback
  { cbConn      :: !(IORef (Maybe NodeConn))
  , cbResult    :: !(MVar (Either String Word64))
  , cbRetries   :: !(IORef Int)
  }

-- Smart contract state
data ContractState = ContractState
  { csBalances  :: !(MVar (Map String Word64))
  , csPool      :: !Pool
  , csPending   :: !(MVar [TxCallback])
  }

mkPool :: Int -> IO Pool
mkPool size = do
  conns <- mapM mkConn [1..fromIntegral size]
  mv <- newMVar conns
  ctr <- newIORef (fromIntegral size)
  return $ Pool mv size ctr
  where
    mkConn i = do
      alive <- newIORef True
      nonce <- newIORef 0
      return $ NodeConn i alive nonce

acquireConn :: Pool -> IO NodeConn
acquireConn pool = modifyMVar (poolConns pool) $ \conns ->
  case conns of
    []     -> do
      ctr <- readIORef (poolCounter pool)
      let newId = ctr + 1
      writeIORef (poolCounter pool) newId
      alive <- newIORef True
      nonce <- newIORef 0
      let c = NodeConn newId alive nonce
      return ([], c)
    (c:cs) -> return (cs, c)

releaseConn :: Pool -> NodeConn -> IO ()
releaseConn pool conn = modifyMVar_ (poolConns pool) $ \conns ->
  return (conn : conns)

-- Invalidate connection (e.g., on network error)
invalidateConn :: NodeConn -> IO ()
invalidateConn conn = writeIORef (connAlive conn) False

-- Submit transaction with async callback
submitTx :: ContractState -> String -> String -> Word64 -> IO (Async (Either String Word64))
submitTx cs from to amount = do
  cb <- mkCallback cs
  -- Acquire connection for this transaction
  conn <- acquireConn (csPool cs)
  writeIORef (cbConn cb) (Just conn)
  -- Register pending callback
  modifyMVar_ (csPending cs) $ \pending -> return (cb : pending)
  -- Launch async operation
  a <- async $ executeTx cs cb from to amount
  return a

mkCallback :: ContractState -> IO TxCallback
mkCallback _cs = do
  connRef <- newIORef Nothing
  result <- newEmptyMVar
  retries <- newIORef 0
  return $ TxCallback connRef result retries

-- Core vulnerability: executeTx releases connection back to pool,
-- but retryTx still references the old connection through cbConn.
-- Another transaction can acquire the same connection, leading to
-- nonce reuse (dangling reference to shared mutable state).
executeTx :: ContractState -> TxCallback -> String -> String -> Word64 -> IO (Either String Word64)
executeTx cs cb from to amount = do
  mconn <- readIORef (cbConn cb)
  case mconn of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "no connection"
    Just conn -> do
      alive <- readIORef (connAlive conn)
      if not alive
        then retryTx cs cb from to amount
        else do
          -- Read and increment nonce
          nonce <- readIORef (connNonce conn)
          writeIORef (connNonce conn) (nonce + 1)
          -- Release connection BEFORE completing the callback
          releaseConn (csPool cs) conn
          -- Simulate network delay
          result <- simulateSubmit from to amount nonce
          case result of
            Left err -> retryTx cs cb from to amount
            Right txId -> do
              putMVar (cbResult cb) (Right txId)
              return $ Right txId

-- Retry reuses the SAME cbConn reference which now points to a
-- connection that has been returned to the pool and potentially
-- acquired by another transaction. The nonce read here may collide.
retryTx :: ContractState -> TxCallback -> String -> String -> Word64 -> IO (Either String Word64)
retryTx cs cb from to amount = do
  retries <- readIORef (cbRetries cb)
  if retries >= 3
    then do
      let err = Left "max retries exceeded"
      putMVar (cbResult cb) err
      return err
    else do
      writeIORef (cbRetries cb) (retries + 1)
      -- BUG: Does NOT clear cbConn or acquire a fresh connection.
      -- The old conn reference is stale — it's back in the pool.
      -- Another async task may have already acquired it and is
      -- using its nonce counter concurrently.
      executeTx cs cb from to amount

simulateSubmit :: String -> String -> Word64 -> Word64 -> IO (Either String Word64)
simulateSubmit from to amount nonce =
  if nonce == 0 && amount > 1000
    then return $ Left "insufficient gas"
    else return $ Right (nonce * 1000 + amount)

-- Entry point for contract interaction
initContract :: IO ContractState
initContract = do
  balances <- newMVar $ Map.fromList [("alice", 10000), ("bob", 5000)]
  pool <- mkPool 2
  pending <- newMVar []
  return $ ContractState balances pool pending

-- Demonstrate the race: two concurrent transactions can get same nonce
demoRace :: IO ()
demoRace = do
  cs <- initContract
  a1 <- submitTx cs "alice" "bob" 1500
  a2 <- submitTx cs "alice" "bob" 200
  r1 <- wait a1
  r2 <- wait a2
  putStrLn $ "Tx1: " ++ show r1
  putStrLn $ "Tx2: " ++ show r2
